name: recorded-evidence-project-isolation
goal: Evidence and artifact requests keep one authorized repository when the selected project changes during a read.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: A request must retain its authorized project context across awaits. A later project selection may not supply its source, history, identity or bytes.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Independent frozen test c53f17f3: two switch cases fail; two controls pass. Evidence returns project B and artifact mixes B history with A files. Red log 7cef9401 retained outside source.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Capture authorized root, source adapter and project ID once. Every awaited scope, identity and artifact step receives that immutable context.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged independent regression c53f17f3 passes all four cases. Durable relative-import copy is in the normal desktop suite; existing artifact and evidence tests are being checked.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
